scenario_a_single_candidate.description: Evaluates whether 1.50% risk allocation is bindingly capped or independently derived.
scenario_a_single_candidate.audit_finding: Raw proposed risk was 3.00% (equal to full unconstrained heat budget), but was constrained by the 1.50% single-strategy ceiling. The 1.50% ceiling is strictly binding.

scenario_b_correlated_same_asset.description: Two positive alphas on SOL/USDT with return correlation +0.1994.
scenario_b_correlated_same_asset.audit_finding: Both strategies are on SOL/USDT. Total SOL risk is capped at 50% of portfolio heat (1.50% total across SOL), forcing competition between the two mechanisms on the same asset.

scenario_c_cross_asset_independent.description: SOL Trend Continuation + BTC Volatility Squeeze (correlation +0.0461).
scenario_c_cross_asset_independent.audit_finding: Because SOL and BTC are distinct assets and correlation is near-zero (0.046), each strategy receives independent risk without hitting asset concentration caps.

scenario_d_three_alpha_competition.description: Three independent positive alphas competing for the 3.00% portfolio heat budget.
scenario_d_three_alpha_competition.audit_finding: Total unconstrained demand was 4.28% risk. The 3.00% portfolio heat ceiling strictly scaled all three candidates proportionally: SOL Set 2: 0.88%, ETH Squeeze: 1.05%, BTC Squeeze: 1.07%. Total heat exactly equals 3.00%.

forward_paper_simulation.sizing_model: Compounding 0.60% equity risk per trade, starting capital $1,000 USD

historical_reconciliation.reconciliation_explanation: The two numbers represent distinct methodologies: +107.41R is the full 5.5-year multi-partition (DEV+VAL+OOS) non-compounding canonical research backtest. +222.92R is the compounding event-driven forward paper simulation conducted over the high-momentum 2024-2026 OOS cycle.

blind_unconstrained_combination_causal.verdict: Blindly adding lookahead-deflated Family 06 instances degrades Sharpe and increases drawdown. The allocator's fail-closed edge filter correctly rejects them.

governed_allocator_decision.allocator_heat_protection: Allocator protects portfolio heat by refusing capital to unvalidated alphas.
